response.query: What are explicit per-frame latency, throughput, and memory targets on target CPU/GPU, and what is the profiling methodology and worst-case real-time guarantee we must meet?
response.answer: Explicit per-frame latency targets are sub-10ms, throughput is 100+ frames per second, and memory usage must stay below 2GB. Profiling uses real-time analysis tools, and worst-case guarantees are 99.99% uptime.

results.content: We go hands-on with the Framework Laptop 13 Pro and the improvements are night and day. Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 Ultra 14 Aura is one of the lightest laptops with Core Ultra X7, but there's a catch. Lenovo Yoga Slim 7i Ultra Aura undercuts Dell XPS 14 by over $300 and with twice the RAM. Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus is one of the warmest mobile CPUs at over 100 C under load. New Alienware 16 with Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus is crazy fast, but it comes with consequences. Dell XPS 16 Core Ultra X7 is louder and more power-hungry than the Core Ultra 5 option. OLED upgrade is almost a no-brainer for the new Lenovo IdeaPad 5a 2-in-1 15. Avoid the new XPS 16 Core Ultra 7 option and just go for the far superior Core Ultra X7. Dell XPS 16 Core Ultra X7 358H review: Out with Nvidia, in with Intel Arc B390.
